en.headline: Safety manager dies after falling 10 floors at Kowloon City site
en.dek: A 39-year-old construction safety manager fell about 10 storeys at a Sa Po Road worksite on Monday afternoon and was later certified dead in hospital.
body: A construction safety manager died after falling roughly 10 floors at a worksite in Kowloon City on Monday.

Authorities received a report at about 12.40pm that a man had plunged from a rooftop and landed on the fourth floor of the site on Sa Po Road. Firefighters found the 39-year-old man unconscious and trapped on scaffolding. It took more than an hour to bring him down to a platform before he was rushed to Kwong Wah Hospital, where he was certified dead at 2.19pm.

Police classified the case as an industrial accident and opened an investigation. The Labour Department also deployed staff to the scene. The victim was reportedly inspecting the rooftop with a colleague when he fell. An advocacy group said the man was married with two young children and had been the family’s main breadwinner.

zh.headline: 九龍城地盤安全主任墮下約十層樓不治
zh.dek: 一名39歲地盤安全主任周一下午在九龍城沙浦道地盤從天台墮下約十層樓，其後送院不治。
body: 一名地盤安全主任周一在九龍城地盤墮樓死亡。
當局約中午12時40分接報，一名男子從天台墮下並落在地盤四樓位置。消防員發現39歲男子昏迷被困棚架，花超過一小時將他救至平台，其後急送廣華醫院，下午2時19分證實死亡。
警方列作工業意外調查，勞工處亦派人到場。據悉死者當時與同事在天台視察時墮下。有關注團體表示，死者已婚並育有兩名年幼子女，是家庭主要經濟支柱。
